releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.47 fixes Instagram Save to Gallery for existing Library carousel posts by using the correct Library media-path separator. Instagram Share now shows the new three-step progress flow (Fetching Instagram media, Saving to Smart Life, Saving to Gallery) and automatically copies successfully fetched media into the Android Gallery after preserving the Smart Life Library copy. A Gallery failure never removes the Library copy and can still be retried from the Library three-dot menu.
